errors.text: The proposed aluminum addition does not reconstruct the demonstrated 4.2 at.% Cr intervention or the resulting reticulated Laves-phase architecture.

No aluminum concentration, substitution scheme, processing route, or phase-stability requirement is specified, so neither density reduction nor formation of the asserted stable solid solution is testably defined.
Retention of mechanical properties through approximately 1000 °C is asserted without supporting evidence or a credible high-temperature deformation and microstructural-stability mechanism.
No supporting prior evidence is cited; all reviewed records are explicitly judged non-transferable.
The rejection criterion uses the undefined phrase 'significant decrease' and supplies no quantitative property thresholds.
